fusions.name: Cold Nail
fusions.desc: Drives a nail of cold metal into the first enemy it meets within 10 tiles, dealing 28 damage that ignores its resistances.

fusions.name: Maiden's Embrace
fusions.desc: Spikes close in around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and stunning each for 1 second. It strips 15% of their armour for 6 seconds and slows each by 20%.

fusions.name: Spellproof Bristle
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 35% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Unyielding Grain
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% arcane resistance.
